sections.h2: What dental clinic management software does
paras: Dental clinic management software runs the four things a practice does every day: books appointments by dentist and chair, keeps a patient record with the treatment notes from each visit, bills the procedure or a stage of a longer plan, and schedules the next sitting. HIMS provides these on the same platform that runs hospitals, configured for a clinic, and there is a dental demo with sample data you can open before a call.

Dental work is episodic. A root canal or an orthodontic course runs across many visits and many bills, so the record has to show what was done last time, what was planned, what was paid and what is due. Treatment notes are recorded per visit against the patient, and the bill can be raised per sitting or against the agreed plan, with the balance visible at the desk.

items.q: Is there a demo for dental clinics?
items.a: Yes. The dental demo runs with sample data so you can see appointments, patient records, treatment notes and billing as a clinic would use them, before booking a call.

items.q: Does it have a tooth chart?
items.a: Treatment is recorded as treatment notes per visit on the patient's record, with the plan and the stages billed. If your practice needs a specific charting format, describe it on the call and it is scoped with the project rather than promised here.

items.q: Can we bill a treatment plan in instalments?
items.a: Yes. A plan can be billed per sitting or per stage, with receipts against it and the balance due shown on the record, so the desk and the patient see the same figure.
Yes. The patient app and portal let patients book an appointment and see upcoming sittings. Walk-ins are still handled at the desk and join the same queue.

items.q: Does it work for a multi-chair clinic with several dentists?
items.a: Yes. Dentists have rosters and each chair has its own slots, so the desk sees which chair is free. Multi-branch chains keep one patient record across branches.

Setup is done by the founder who built it, in person in Chennai or remotely elsewhere, with your existing patient list brought in from Excel and support on WhatsApp after go-live. Delivery follows a 30-working-day framework where scope allows.
